text:
maria.sales: Customer (global bank) wants to run a 6-week isolated POC in their secured datacenter. Requirements: fully air-gapped delivery, signed offline bundles, per-instance license files validated locally (no outbound), monthly or ad-hoc patch cadence, and the ability to rollback model bundles if quantization causes quality regressions. They also insist that transfer windows are <10GB per shipment.

ryan.eng: Technical note 1 we can produce signed tarballs and chunked deltas. Rollback across quantization formats may need cache clears and a cold restart. Suggest we include a compatibility manifest to prevent unsafe rollbacks. Need to know whether operator allowed to run scripts or if changes must be orchestrator-driven.

noah.sec: From security: HSM or customer-managed KMS only. No outbound phone-home. We can support signed license blobs that verify with embedded public key. Will require export-control check on crypto libs in bundle. Also request for completed security questionnaire answers.

jordana.se: Operational constraints 1 if transfers are limited to 10GB, we'll chunk model weights and provide per-chunk checksums + an index. We'll ship a runbook for staged manual canary -> farm rollout, with smoke tests for validation.

olivia.prod: Pricing flag from procurement: extra packaging fee + monthly retainer for managed patching. Proposed ballpark: $10k one-time packaging + $1.2k/month support. Confirm SOW language for "airgap packaging", "signed license issuance", and "per-transfer verification support".

artifact-bot: [artifact#452] created offline-bundle v2.0.1 (sha256:ef12be...) 1 artifacts in internal-artifacts (VPN).

maria.sales: Action items: 1) ask customer which transfer mechanisms they permit (USB / courier / SFTP over screened jumpbox); 2) confirm KMS/HSM model and activation token acceptance; 3) deliver draft SOW + pricing; 4) provide runbook + signed bundle. @ryan.eng @jordana.se please add technical checklist items.

ryan.eng: Will add compatibility matrix, chunking plan, and offline license verification flow by EOD tomorrow.

jordana.se: Will draft runbook and example rollback script and post here later today.

maria.sales: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
